crossRefs.note: I waited patiently until morning. He breaks all my bones like a lion. From day even to night you will make an end of me.
He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in secret places.
Therefore I am like a lion to them. Like a leopard, I will lurk by the path.
I will meet them like a bear that is bereaved of her cubs, and will tear the covering of their heart. There I will…
The lion has roared. Who will not fear? The Lord Yahweh has spoken. Who can but prophesy?
If these men die the common death of all men, or if they experience what all men experience, then Yahweh hasn’t sent me.
But if Yahweh makes a new thing, and the ground opens its mouth, and swallows them up with all that belong to them, and…
then Yahweh will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful, even great plagues, and of long duration…

translations.web: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.
translations.bsb: Should I hold my head high, You would hunt me like a lion, and again display Your power against me.
translations.kjv: For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: and again thou shewest thyself marvellous
translations.asv: And if my head exalt itself, thou huntest me as a lion; And again thou showest thyself marvellous upon me.
